caveats: ⚑ MP economy: the kit's two replenish gates read literally as MP==0 (Burst Stage 1 entry) and MP>1 (Full Burst entry), which leaves MP permanently stuck at 1 and makes both the stated cap of 12 and the burst's MP-scaled repeat unreachable. Modeled as MP>=1 on the Full-Burst line (whole-picture: the derived cycle burst-consume→0, stage-1 re-seed→1, FB→2 is the only reading in which every kit clause is live). If footage shows MP never exceeding 1, revert to min:2.

⚑ Burst repeat count: 'Attacks repeatedly based on current MP' is modeled as a single flatDamage at 1372.8% × 3 (estimated MP-at-cast). The engine has no MP-scaled hit count for flatDamage, so the multiplier is baked in — it is an UNMEASURED steady-state estimate, not a mechanic.

⚑ Burst HP term: the kit multiplies 1372.8% against (10% of final Max HP + ATK). flatDamage can only express % of final ATK, so ONLY the ATK term is modeled; the 10%-Max-HP term is missing damage (grows with the S1 Max HP stacks and any HP gear). Needs an engine primitive or an ATK-equivalent conversion measured from a fight.

⚑ Max HP stacks do NOT reach cap: the 6-full-charge trigger fires roughly once per magazine (6 ammo × ~1s charge + ~2.35s reload ≈ 9s) while each stack lasts 15s, so steady state is ~1.7 stacks (~11% Max HP), not the 63.4% cap. Any tuning that assumes 10 stacks will over-credit atkOfMaxHpPct.

⚑ The two skill2 'MP is replenished' blocks mirror the skill1 replenish triggers/gates rather than keying a real replenish event; their resourceGates are written to be correct under either slot evaluation order, with one known edge (MP==1 at a Burst-Stage-1 entry, i.e. a rotation where the chain fails after her re-seed, fires the ally buff without an actual replenish).
⚑ crit:true on the 547.62% charge rider and the burst nuke follows the rider-crit convention (riders crit at the caster's sheet rate, no core); unverified for this unit.

⚑ Cadence: chargeFrames 60 / ammo 6 / reloadFrames 141 are datamined and drive BOTH the 547.62%-per-charge rider and the 6-charge stack trigger — a cadence error scales her whole non-burst output linearly.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Model: an MP resource pool (0..12) seeded +1 at Burst Stage 1 entry while empty and +1 per Full Burst entry, spent in full on her own burst cast. Skill 2 mirrors those replenish moments to grant Electric allies (excluding self) Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲40.9% + ATK ▲20.9% of caster ATK for 10s, and gives herself Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲31.68% + ATK ▲3.2% of her own final Max HP for 10s when MP is spent. Every full charge deals a 547.62% single-target rider; every 6th full charge stacks Max HP ▲6.34% for 15s (cap 10, realistically ~1.7 stacks). Burst is one crit-eligible instant hit at 1372.8% of ATK multiplied by an ESTIMATED 3 MP repeats, with the kit's 10%-Max-HP term absent from the multiplier.

flags.reasoning: Taken literally the pair of gates is MP==0 → +1 and MP>1 → +1, so MP can never leave 1: the stated 12 cap, the 'all MP consumed on burst' clause and the burst's MP-scaled repeat all become dead text. Whole-picture, the only reading where every clause is live is >=1, giving the cycle burst→0, Stage-1 re-seed→1, FB→+1 per rotation.
flags.recipe: Record one fight with her in a 2×B3 comp; read the MP counter on her portrait at each Burst Stage 1 entry and each Full Burst entry. If MP is observed at 2+, min:1 is confirmed; if it pins at 1 all fight, set min:2 and drop the burst repeat multiplier to 1.

flags.reasoning: Kit-stated start/consume/rebuild lets the trajectory be derived: MP=0 after her cast, +1 at the next Stage-1 entry, +1 per Full Burst thereafter, with a 40s burst CD meaning she casts roughly every 2nd rotation → ~2–3 MP at cast, nowhere near the 12 cap. 3 is the optimistic end of that derivation.
flags.recipe: Count her burst damage popups per cast in footage (each repeat is its own popup), or read the MP counter on the frame before her burst banner; average over ≥3 casts, then set atkPct = 1372.8 × measured mean.

flags.estimate: 0 modeled (ATK term only) — likely 5–15% of the burst's true magnitude
flags.reasoning: The kit multiplies 1372.8% against (0.10 × final Max HP + ATK). flatDamage.atkPct is % of final ATK only, and her final Max HP is itself dynamic (S1 stacks + HP gear), so no static atkPct bump is faithful. Under-credits her burst, and the gap grows with HP investment.
flags.recipe: From a Base-5 scope-lock sheet read her final Max HP and ATK, compute (0.10×HP)/ATK, and either add that fraction to atkPct as a documented static conversion or add an engine hpPct term to flatDamage; verify against a burst popup on a fight where her stack count is known.

flags.estimate: ~1 full charge per ~1.1s within a 6-round magazine, ~9s per magazine cycle (chargeFrames 60, ammo 6, reloadFrames 141)
flags.reasoning: Datamined charge/reload fields are the known-unreliable class, and BOTH the 547.62% rider (every charge) and the Max HP stack (every 6 charges) scale linearly with this cadence — a 20% cadence error is a 20% error on the bulk of her non-burst damage.
flags.recipe: Frame-count one magazine in footage: charge-start → shot for the per-charge time, last shot → first shot of the next magazine for reload; compare against 60/141 frames and correct the override's dependent estimates.

flags.estimate: ~1.7 of 10 stacks (~11% Max HP), not the 63.4% cap
flags.reasoning: Trigger period (6 full charges ≈ one magazine ≈ 9s) exceeds half the 15s stack duration, so stacks expire nearly as fast as they accrue. This is the input to her own atkOfMaxHpPct conversion and to the burst's HP term, so an at-cap assumption over-credits both.
flags.recipe: Once cadence is measured, read the buff-icon stack count on her portrait at several timestamps (early / mid / late fight) and confirm the plateau; no rampSec is authored since the engine accrues the stacks naturally.

flags.estimate: max:1 on the Stage-1 mirror, min:1 on the Full-Burst mirror

These bounds evaluate TRUE under both pre-increment and post-increment reads, making them independent of skill1-vs-skill2 block ordering. Known edge: MP==1 at a Stage-1 entry (a rotation where the chain fails right after her re-seed) fires the ally buff with no real replenish.
flags.recipe: Assert with the harness: patch in the override, run controlComp with an Electric ally, and check the buffApply stream — one elemAdvantageDamagePct 40.9 application per actual MP gain, none on rotations where MP is unchanged.

flags.reasoning: Rider convention: function damage crits at the caster's rate but takes no core unless the text says 'core strike damage', which it does not here. Unverified for this unit specifically.
